review:
Smokey leads the stadium chants in the gentlest Le game. Cluster wins turn into glowing Marked Squares, which can become Coins, Clovers and Buckets of Gold.

Three, four or five FS symbols trigger one of three bonus games. It's rated 2/5 – the lowest in the series – with a 2,500x max and RTP versions of 96.41%, 94.29% and 92.30%. One of the calmest Hacksaw games: all the Le fun without the big swings.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Casinos can run versions as low as 92.30% RTP
Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
